Overview

What is customized cut frosted film?

Design & privacy

Installed on-site across Qatar

Add a modern touch with customized cut frosted film — perfect for offices, clinics, showrooms and homes. Our frosted window designs enhance privacy and aesthetics, cut precisely to your pattern, logo or dimensions.

Frosted film gives glass an elegant etched-glass look at a fraction of the cost. We cut it to any pattern — geometric, floral, Islamic-inspired motifs, gradients or your brand logo — to create privacy exactly where you need it.

Our process

Five steps to a flawless finish

  1. 1

    Consultation

    We understand your goals — heat, privacy, protection or design — and recommend the ideal film.

  2. 2

    Site assessment

  3. 3

    Every surface is deep-cleaned for perfect, bubble-free adhesion.

FAQ

Customized Cut Frosted Film FAQ

Still have a question?

Our specialists reply fast on WhatsApp, 7 days a week.

WhatsApp us Call us
Can you cut my company logo?

Yes. Send us your logo file and we’ll prepare a proof before cutting and installing.

Is frosted film permanent?

It’s long-lasting but removable, so you can refresh your design later without changing the glass.

Do you have ready-made patterns?

We have a wide range of designs, or we can create a fully custom pattern for your space.
